stories.title: 马斯克的 Grokipedia 发布 v0.3 更新：换新 Logo，首页和实时编辑页改版
stories.sourceTitle: Elon Musk’s Grokipedia has a ‘newly refreshed’ design
stories.summary: SpaceXAI 的 AI 版维基百科竞品 Grokipedia 推出 v0.3 更新，加入新 Logo，并刷新首页与 live edits 页面；此前它已重新开始纳入用户编辑。
stories.analysis: 这次更新说明 Grokipedia 仍在迭代产品形态，但能否解决 AI 生成内容可信度与编辑治理问题才是关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Grokipedia, SpaceXAI's AI-powered competitor to Wikipedia, recently started incorporating edits again, and today, it got some design tweaks as part of a v0.3 update, including a new logo and refreshes to its homepage and live edits page. SpaceXAI head of desig

stories.title: AI 版“电子宠物”要来了：Meta 和 OpenAI 明年将押注专用 AI 设备
stories.sourceTitle: The AI Tamagotchis are coming
stories.summary: 报道称 Meta 和 OpenAI 将在未来一年尝试用专用设备切入 AI 硬件，此前 AI 在手机和电脑上进展快，但在独立设备上大多失败。两家公司似乎押注相似路径。
stories.analysis: 如果专用 AI 硬件仍找不到高频刚需，可能重演智能音箱或可穿戴的尴尬，但大模型交互也可能带来新入口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: While AI has made plenty of inroads on people's phones and computers, it's largely failed in dedicated devices. But over the next year, two major AI companies, Meta and OpenAI, will attempt to change that. And they're apparently betting on a similar path: test

stories.title: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Argon，称其为迄今最强模型
stories.sourceTitle: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
stories.summary: Google 推出新一代 Gemini 模型 Gemini 4 Argon，主打编程与网络安全工作负载，并称其为目前最强模型。
stories.analysis: Google 把前沿模型能力直接对标代码和安全场景，意在争夺企业级高价值 Agent 市场。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google has released its latest Gemini model, marketing it as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity work.

stories.title: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Argon：能力太强，目前仅限“可信网络安全防御者”使用
stories.sourceTitle: Google announces Gemini 4 and says it’s so capable that only ‘trusted cyber defenders’ can have it right now
stories.summary: Google 公布下一代前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon，称其在软件工程、法律金融等企业知识工作及网络安全防御中达到前沿性能，但当前仅向可信网络安全防御者开放。
stories.analysis: 这种受限发布策略反映出前沿模型在网络安全能力上的双用途风险，也预示模型访问将更多与信任分级绑定。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google today revealed its next AI frontier model, which it's calling Gemini 4 Argon. The new model delivers "frontier performance in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity d

stories.title: AI 高管如何评价特朗普的新 AI 安全计划
stories.sourceTitle: Here’s what AI leaders are saying about Trump’s new safety plan
stories.summary: 特朗普与大型科技公司高管会面后，回应了其 AI 安全相关声明的提问，并提到自己此前称 AI 安全担忧是“骗局”的说法。报道汇总了 AI 领导人的反应。
stories.analysis: 政治人物对 AI 安全的摇摆表述，可能让企业合规预期更不稳定，也削弱公众对安全承诺的信任。
stories.sourceExcerpt: After hosting a meal with Big Tech leaders on Tuesday, President Donald Trump responded to journalist questions about his artificial intelligence announcements in typical fashion. He said his previous claims regarding fears around AI safety being a "hoax" cook

stories.title: Flow Engineering 获 Valor、Atreides 和 Sequoia 投资，估值达 7.5 亿美元
stories.sourceTitle: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
stories.summary: 这家把 AI Agent 带入硬件设计的初创公司完成融资，估值 7.5 亿美元，红杉的 Roelof Botha 也以天使投资人身份加入董事会。
stories.analysis: 资本开始押注 AI Agent 进入硬件设计这类高门槛工程场景，说明垂直 Agent 正从软件流程走向实体产品开发。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Flow Engineering, which is bringing AI agents to hardware design, also landed Roelof Botha as an angel investor and board member.

stories.title: OpenAI 的 Jev 克隆版 Decisions API，或帮其控制蜂群式 Agent
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI’s Jev clone could help the frontier lab stop its swarming agents
stories.summary: OpenAI 推出“Decisions API”，被描述为 Jev 克隆，强调快速、廉价智能的重要性。报道认为它可能帮助前沿实验室管理大规模 swarm agents。
stories.analysis: 当 Agent 从单个助手变成蜂群，低成本实时决策层可能成为控制与协调的关键基础设施。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI's "Decisions API" is a Jev clone that confirms the importance of fast, cheap intelligence.

stories.title: AI 语音初创公司 ElevenLabs 估值翻倍至 220 亿美元
stories.sourceTitle: AI voice startup ElevenLabs doubles valuation to $22B
stories.summary: ElevenLabs 完成由 Wellington 和 T. Rowe Price 联合领投的 3 亿美元员工股权出售，估值达到 220 亿美元。
stories.analysis: 语音 AI 的商业化潜力继续被资本市场重估，员工 tender 也说明公司希望用流动性留住人才。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The $300 million employee tender was co-led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price.

stories.title: Meta 的 Muse AI Agent 最新动态：可爱又令人不安，能发邮件也能网购
stories.sourceTitle: All the latest news on Meta’s cute, creepy Muse AI agent
stories.summary: Meta 推出 Muse AI Agent，声称可帮用户发邮件、在线购物等；报道称它执行任务时可能出乎意料地有效，但前提是用户愿意把数据和账号交给 Meta。
stories.analysis: Muse 的能力越强，Meta 的隐私与授权边界就越敏感，信任会成为其产品采用的最大变量。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta launched a new Muse AI agent it claims can help you with everything from firing off emails to buying stuff online. Muse can be surprisingly effective at delivering on those promises — if you’re willing to trust Meta with your data and hand Muse your credi

stories.title: OpenAI 称已阻断一次有组织的模型蒸馏攻击
stories.sourceTitle: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
stories.summary: OpenAI 披露其阻断了一场提取受保护模型推理过程的 campaign，并正在加强对对抗性蒸馏的防御。
stories.analysis: 模型蒸馏攻击直接威胁 API 商业模式和模型安全，前沿实验室将更多以技术加法律手段反制。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how OpenAI disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.

stories.title: Reddit 因 AI 机器人停掉 RSS 订阅并终止公共 API 访问
stories.sourceTitle: Reddit is killing RSS feeds and ending public API access because of AI bots
stories.summary: Reddit 宣布停止支持 RSS feeds，进一步收紧对其用户生成内容库的访问，报道称此举与 AI 机器人抓取有关。
stories.analysis: 内容平台与 AI 爬虫的矛盾升级，公开数据源正被逐步关闭，可能推高模型训练与检索成本。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Reddit is ending support for RSS feeds, as the company continues tightening access to its trove of user-generated content.

stories.title: 消费级 AI 的难看经济学：前沿实验室为何对 to C 谨慎
stories.sourceTitle: The ugly economics of consumer AI
stories.summary: TechCrunch 分析指出，前沿实验室对消费级 AI 变得谨慎，原因并非技术不够好，而是商业经济性不佳。
stories.analysis: 消费级 AI 获客与推理成本高、付费转化难，可能迫使更多公司转向企业级和 API 收入。
stories.sourceExcerpt: There’s a reason frontier labs have gotten gun-shy about consumer AI — and it’s not because the tech isn’t good enough.

stories.title: Google 据报试水向出版商付费，换取 AI 搜索结果内容
stories.sourceTitle: Google reportedly tests paying publishers for AI search results
stories.summary: The Information 报道称 Google 启动试点，向约 100 家出版商付费，以补偿其内容对 AI 搜索功能的贡献；Google 正因 AI 搜索与出版业关系面临审查。
stories.analysis: 若付费模式成立，可能重塑搜索与内容方的利益分配，但规模与透明度仍待观察。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google has launched a pilot program that pays publishers for their contributions to its AI-powered search features, according to a report from The Information. The pilot program reportedly includes around 100 publishers and comes as Google faces scrutiny over

stories.title: Instagram 为 Edits 加入 AI 创意助手，指导用户如何发帖
stories.sourceTitle: Instagram is adding an AI ‘assistant’ to tell you how to post
stories.summary: Instagram 宣布其独立 Edits 应用将加入 AI“创意助手”，从平台数据中提取信息，为用户提供发帖反馈和建议。
stories.analysis: 社交平台正把 AI 从内容生成延伸到发布指导，目标是提升创作者发帖频率和内容表现。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Instagram is the latest social media platform to add built-in AI-powered features that will give users feedback on their posts. The company announced Wednesday that its standalone Edits app will now include an AI "creative assistant" that pulls in data from a

stories.title: 特朗普版 AI 安全协议细节：科技领袖将如何自我监管
stories.sourceTitle: Here’s how tech leaders will self-police AI safety under Trump’s deal
stories.summary: 报道披露特朗普宣布的“道德约束”AI 安全协议全文，顶级高管同意对前沿 AI 技术进行自我监管，协议正式名称为 Joint Commitment on Frontier...。
stories.analysis: 自我监管缺乏强制力，可能引发对执行与问责的质疑。
stories.sourceExcerpt: We now have the full details of the "morally binding" AI safety deal announced by President Trump yesterday, in which top executives agreed to self-regulate their artificial intelligence technology. The accord, officially titled the Joint Commitment on Frontie

stories.title: OpenAI 与美国 SBDC 合作，帮小企业落地 AI
stories.sourceTitle: Helping small businesses put AI to work
stories.summary: OpenAI 宣布与美国 SBDC 合作，扩大小企业 AI 实操培训与本地支持，并发布关于小团队如何使用 AI 的新报告。
stories.analysis: 这是 OpenAI 渗透长尾企业市场、培养未来 API 客户的教育型渠道策略。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is partnering with America’s SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, alongside a new report on how small teams are using AI.

stories.title: Meta 否认 Muse 未经许可读取用户私信
stories.sourceTitle: Meta disputes claim that Muse read a user’s private messages without permission
stories.summary: Meta 称其 Muse AI Agent 未经明确许可无法访问用户 Messages，否认一名记者关于 Muse 在关闭 Mac 设置后仍读取其私信的指控。
stories.analysis: Agent 权限与操作系统设置之间的不一致会放大隐私争议，Meta 需要更清晰的技术说明和审计。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta says its Muse AI agent cannot access a user’s Messages without explicit permission, disputing a journalist’s account that the agent read his private messages while the required Mac setting was turned off.

stories.title: DoorDash 推出可短信点餐的 AI Agent
stories.sourceTitle: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
stories.summary: DoorDash 上线 AI Agent，用户可通过文字消息下单点餐，意在对抗 Uber Eats 和 Grubhub 的竞争中取得优势。
stories.analysis: 外卖平台把对话式 AI 当作新的下单入口，关键是能否提高转化并降低客服成本。
stories.sourceExcerpt: By launching an AI agent for food ordering, DoorDash is looking to gain an edge over rivals Uber Eats and Grubhub.

stories.title: Destro AI 的秘诀：让机器人和人类在同一页上协作
stories.sourceTitle: Destro AI’s secret sauce is getting robots and humans on the same page
stories.summary: Destro AI 表示，其击败机器人公司的最大原因之一，是它并不是一家机器人公司，而是解决机器人与人类协同的问题。
stories.analysis: 在机器人赛道，软件协调层可能比硬件本身更具差异化，也更容易规模化。
stories.sourceExcerpt: "One of the biggest reasons we are winning against robotics companies is because we are not a robotics company."

stories.title: Instinct 新商品推荐让部分用户感到“被冒犯”
stories.sourceTitle: Instinct’s new product recommendations are giving some users the ick
stories.summary: Instinct 推出人工策展的商品和旅行推荐，但部分用户对未经请求就收到建议感到不满。
stories.analysis: 推荐功能若越界成打扰，会迅速消耗用户信任，算法推荐需更尊重同意与场景。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Instinct is rolling out human-curated product and travel recommendations, but some users aren’t happy about getting suggestions they never asked for.

stories.title: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman 将在 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 谈 AI 能否持续 scaling
stories.sourceTitle: Cerebras Systems’ Andrew Feldman on whether AI can keep scaling at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.summary: Cerebras Systems CEO 兼联合创始人 Andrew Feldman 将在 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 讨论算力、能源和基础设施需求增长，以及如果现有 AI 硬件路线触顶后会发生什么。
stories.analysis: 算力扩张的瓶颈已从芯片转向能源和基础设施，Cerebras 的差异化叙事将接受公开检验。
stories.sourceExcerpt: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, Cerebras Systems CEO and co-founder Andrew Feldman will explore the growing demand for compute, energy, and infrastructure, how Cerebras is approaching those constraints differently, and what comes next if today’s AI hardware reache

stories.title: Restate 融资 2000 万美元，为 AI Agent 提供持久化基础设施
stories.sourceTitle: Restate lands $20M as the need for durable infrastructure increases with AI agents
stories.summary: Restate 完成 2000 万美元融资，其持久执行引擎没有基于外部数据库，而是自建存储、复制和冗余层，以实现高速轻量。随着 AI Agent 普及，持久化基础设施需求增加。
stories.analysis: Agent 任务链路越长，状态可靠越关键，Restate 试图在基础设施层卡住 Agent 工作流。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Instead of building its durable execution engine on top of an external database, the company developed its own storage, replication, and redundancy layers. This architecture allows Restate to be exceptionally fast and lightweight.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 参展报名还剩 3 天
stories.sourceTitle: 3 days left to exhibit: Turn visibility into your next opportunity at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 参展报名将于 10 月 2 日 23:59 PT 截止，主办方称可向 1 万多名创始人、投资人、运营者和科技领袖展示初创项目。
stories.analysis: 这类大会仍是 AI 初创集中曝光和融资对接的节点，但参展回报取决于能否精准触达目标投资人。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Three days left to exhibit at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Book by October 2 at 11:59 p.m. PT to showcase your startup to 10,000+ founders, investors, operators, and tech leaders.

stories.title: Airbnb 加入 AI 搜索和更多社交功能
stories.sourceTitle: Airbnb adds AI search, more social features
stories.summary: Airbnb 新增 AI 搜索与更多社交功能，并将在部分地点推出送餐、洗衣等新服务。
stories.analysis: Airbnb 试图用 AI 搜索改善发现体验、用服务扩展提高客单价，但运营复杂度也会上升。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Airbnb is also launching new services such as meal delivery and laundry in select locations.

stories.title: Sam Altman：在模型足够安全前，OpenAI 不会上市
stories.sourceTitle: Sam Altman says OpenAI won’t go public until its models are safe
stories.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 表示，在公司能对模型安全做出更好承诺之前不会 IPO，目前也没有明确时间表；他仍希望继续推进 AI 进展。
stories.analysis: 把上市与安全承诺绑定，既是治理姿态也是估值策略，但缺乏时间表会让市场更难定价。
stories.sourceExcerpt: For months, people have wondered when OpenAI will go public. CEO Sam Altman says it won't happen until the company can make better promises about model safety, with no firm timeline in sight. "We intend to continue with AI progress … but as the models have had

stories.title: 机房堆满算力卡，业务却还在排队？这份评估报告拆开了“算力荒假象”的破局账本
stories.sourceTitle: 机房堆满算力卡，业务却还在排队？这份评估报告拆开了“算力荒假象”的破局账本
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文文章讨论机房堆满算力卡但业务仍排队的问题，并借评估报告拆解所谓“算力荒假象”的破局账本。
stories.analysis: 算力利用率与调度瓶颈可能比绝对算力短缺更值得关注，企业应复盘资源分配和软件栈效率。

stories.title: OpenAI 推理之父最新访谈：数学只是多智能体时代的开胃菜
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI推理之父最新访谈！数学只是多智能体时代的开胃菜
stories.summary: 量子位报道，OpenAI 推理之父在最新访谈中谈到，千禧年难题的突破中，10000 个 Agent 最多只占 10% 的功劳。
stories.analysis: 这暗示多智能体协作的潜力远未释放，数学突破或许只是检验 Agent 系统能力的一个起点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 千禧年难题的突破，10000个Agent最多占了10%的功劳。

stories.title: Qwen 发布 Qwen3Guard：面向 Token 流的实时安全护栏

stories.analysis: 开源模型家族补齐安全护栏，有助于开发者在合规敏感场景中落地，但实时拦截效果仍需实测。
